definitions.starfold_recovery: adjusted Rand index (floored at 0) against the true classes on the assigned rows, times the share of rows assigned, for the selected setting
definitions.defaults_recovery: median of the same quantity for the UMAP and HDBSCAN library defaults over 8 seeds
definitions.spearman_score_recovery: Spearman correlation of the label-free trial score with the recovery of each trial, over the search trials of that table
definitions.class_size_over_scale: 0.8 n / classes divided by sqrt(15 x 0.8 n): the mean class size in an 80 percent resample over the modularity resolution scale, as in bench/figures.py
definitions.injection: synthetic groups of declared size were injected into the real APOGEE DR19 example table (2,000 rows) as a check of the method; a group counts as retrieved when an emitted group reaches Jaccard 0.5 with it; purity and completeness are averaged over the three injected groups at each support threshold; purity is null where no group matched; the injected rows are never kept (bench/injection_recovery.py)
